rewards.description: The rewards, in the order offers draw them from.

ContentId.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-026): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

Rarity.description: A reward's rarity, from the most common up (ADR-066 §2).

Reward.description: One reward an offer can hold.

amount.description:
What taking it adds to the effect's total, from 1 to `MAX_AMOUNT`; for a stage skill,
the levels it gives, from 1 to `MAX_SKILL_LEVELS`.

description.description: What it does, in words, at most `run_stats::MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS` characters.

id.description: The reward's own ID, unique within the file.

limit.description: The most times one run takes it, from 1 to `MAX_STACK`.

skill.description:
The stage skill it gives, one of the stage skills file's: with the `stage_skill` effect
only, and required by it.

title.description: The name the choice screen shows, 1 to `run_stats::MAX_TITLE_CHARS` characters.

RewardEffect.description:
What taking a reward does: one of the run stats' effect kinds, under the same names, or a
stage skill.

oneOf.description: The stage skill the reward's `skill` names, `amount` levels of it (ADR-075).
